subject: library(shiny) required inside server.R and ui.R

messages.author: 2de7c33d05dd213b
messages.subject: library(shiny) required inside server.R and ui.R
parts:
The first time I tried to deploy an app to http://dmitri.shinyapps.io/test I got an error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Waiting for task: 13222
  building: Processing Bundle Id: 10313
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 13223 failed: Error downloading bundle: Error fetching bundle: HTTP 599: Operation timed out after 300040 milliseconds with 0 out of -1 bytes received

Then I added "library(shiny)" to both server.R and ui.R and it worked.

I repeated the experiment trying to deploy the initial files (without "library(shiny)") to http://dmitri.shinyapps.io/test2 and got one step further, but it ended up with an error again:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Waiting for task: 13243
  building: Building 15 packages
  building: Building package xtable-1.7-1
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 13244 error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 13245 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Operation timed out after 300041 milliseconds with 0 out of -1 bytes received

shiny::runApp() works perfectly without loading shiny package inside server.R and ui.R, you could add this deployApp() vs runApp() difference to manual.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] library(shiny) required inside server.R and ui.R
parts:
Dmitri,

The issue you are seeing is unrelated to the inclusion of library(shiny). Library shiny is automatically included as a dependency of the application is not required to be loaded explicitly. The errors you are seeing are related to a known issue with the ShinyApps platform itself. The issue is transient, so running deployApp() again may work. We are currently working on a fix for this issue so the HTTP timeouts will hopefully go away soon.

Thanks,
-Andy
